name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 0.93 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
